description.p: Crossfade is a virtual audio mixer for PipeWire that gives every input channel two independent faders: a Monitor Mix for what you hear, and a Stream Mix for what your audience hears. The Stream Mix appears as a virtual microphone, “Crossfade Stream Mix”, that you select in OBS, Discord or any other application. No special hardware required.

ul.li: Up to eight input channels, fed from microphones and other capture devices, from groups of running applications, or from virtual output devices
An “Other Apps” channel that catches every application no other channel claims
An optional VOD Mix with its own virtual microphone, to keep music out of your recordings while it still plays live
Per-channel and master volume and mute for every mix, fader linking, and live stereo level meters
MIDI controller support with MIDI learn, binding profiles, fader pickup and LED feedback
A D-Bus control API for scripts, hotkeys and stream-deck tools
Self-healing routing that puts streams back when the session manager moves them

description.p: Crossfade needs PipeWire with its PulseAudio server (pipewire-pulse).

screenshot.caption: The mixer with Monitor and Stream faders per channel

ul.li: The setup assistant checks the routing of every Elgato Wave interface, not only the Wave XLR
Crossfade now also runs on Windows, as a preview
Relicensed under the Apache License 2.0
Application channels can hold several apps, plus name patterns such as Firefox*
New “Other Apps” channel that picks up every app no other channel claims
Application channels are also selectable as output devices
Tray indicator showing and toggling the microphone’s mute state

description.p: OpenWave is now Gleem Crossfade. The virtual microphones are renamed to “Crossfade Stream Mix” and “Crossfade VOD Mix”; existing configurations are migrated automatically.

ul.li: Per-channel colors, with MIDI pads that light up as channel locators
MIDI controller support with MIDI learn, binding profiles, fader pickup and LED feedback
D-Bus control API for volumes, mutes and MIDI profiles
Optional VOD Mix: a third mix with its own virtual microphone for recording tracks
A single link toggle ties all of a channel’s faders together
New channels start muted in the Stream and VOD mixes

description.p: Packaging and release automation only; no changes to the app.

ul.li: Input routing self-heals: channels wait for missing capture devices and reconnect when they appear
Fixed a silent Elgato Wave XLR microphone after login
Wave XLR levels are enforced reliably after start and replug
No more brief full-volume blips when routes are created
Level meters use a dBFS scale with PPM-style ballistics
Separate left and right meters for stereo inputs and mixes
Elgato Wave XLR dialog for mic gain, headphone volume and monitor mix
Audio setup assistant with one-click fixes
Removing a channel now asks for confirmation

description.p: Per-channel effects with VST2, VST3 and LV2 plugins.
